scenarios.name: Standard start
scenarios.description: Found a small company with your own savings in any of the three cities. Enough for a garage, a workshop or a small industrial unit. Nothing is provided: no premises, staff, machines or stock.

scenarios.name: Backed start
scenarios.description: Found the company with a large sum from the owner, enough to lease a warehouse or a factory. Everything inside it must still be bought and hired.

scenarios.name: Quick Start
scenarios.description: Skip the setup: Harlow Precision Works is founded with $50,000 and leases the workshop at 8 Canal Street, Harlow Falls, for a year. The workshop is empty.
